component.name: word-sys's PDF Editor
component.summary: Edit text content in PDF files

description.p: An open-source tool for editing content in PDF files on Linux. Edit text and images directly on the page, merge and reorder pages, draw shapes and highlights, and export to PDF or plain text.

screenshot.caption: Editing text and annotations in a PDF file
Interactive Quick Start Guide and keyboard shortcuts cheatsheet

description.p: Customizable New Document creation dialog with 18 presets and unit conversion, redesigned interactive Quick Start Guide with keyboard shortcuts cheatsheet, decoupled focal pointer zoom with Cairo surface caching, transparent PNG alpha preservation, vector stroke scaling, Linux fontconfig engine, and modernized PyMuPDF integration.
Adds freehand pen and highlighter drawing tools, checkmark and cross vector stamping, special characters and emoji palette, single-key shortcuts, keyboard nudge movement, and direct handle resizing.
GTK file dialog version compatibility fix, export format resolution fix, and Pango markup escaping for recent files.
Adds hyperlink annotation support with link de-duplication, plus localization and bold-underline fixes.
